Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class RunResolver

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.RunResolver
public final class RunResolver extends Object
Decides what a string typed into the Alt+F2 run dialog should do, without touching Swing or spawning anything — the pure seam behind RunDialog.

Resolution mirrors the way a person uses a run box:

  1. An exact (case-insensitive) match against a start-menu application name launches that application's Desktop2DMenuConfig.ItemSpec, so typing "Calculator" behaves exactly like picking Calculator from the menu.
  2. Otherwise, a string that classifies as an external command (Desktop2DAppRegistry.Kind.EXTERNAL) whose executable is on the PATH runs as a child process, so typing "firefox" or "xterm -ls" works.
  3. Anything else — blank input, an unknown name, or an external command whose executable is missing — resolves to RunResolver.Type.NOT_FOUND.

The PATH lookup is injected as a Predicate so the whole decision table can be exercised headless and deterministically; the no-argument overload supplies the real Desktop2DAppRegistry.isExternalAvailable(java.lang.String).
